description: Post a draft now to every account in it. Call it only after the user said yes to this post. Answers one delivery per account in state queued, which means accepted, not posted: read jobs_get for the outcome and the link to the live post. One call counts as one post on the plan.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8 to 200 chars, e.g. UUID). Reusing it after a timeout returns the same jobs and never double-posts.

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.

name: publish
title: Publish now
